## Summary

<!-- What changed and why? One or two sentences. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] UI or design change
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build or CI

## Testing

<!-- Commands you ran and anything you checked by hand. -->

- [ ] `npm run flutter -- analyze --no-pub` (app changes)
- [ ] `npm run flutter -- test --no-pub` (app changes)
- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test`
- [ ] `npm run web:typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run web:lint`
- [ ] `npm run web:build`
- [ ] `npm run web:cloudflare:build` (web changes)
- [ ] `npm run api:test` (API changes)

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to one logical fix or feature.
- [ ] No API keys, `.env` files, keystores or downloaded media are included.
- [ ] New UI works at 360px wide and on desktop.
- [ ] Related issues are linked with `Fixes #…`.
